hits.title: Cellebrite Appoints Shiven Ramji Chief Executive Officer, Succeeding Thomas E. Hogan
hits.snippet: TYSONS CORNER, Va. and PETAH TIKVA, Israel, Aug. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Cellebrite DI Ltd. (NASDAQ: CLBT), a global leader in AI-powered Digital Investigative and Intelligence solutions for the public and private sectors, today announced that Shiven Ramji, who joined Cellebrite as President, Products and Technology in May 2026, has succeeded Thomas E. Hogan as the Company's CEO as part of a planned transition, effective immediately. In addition, Ramji will be appointed to the Company's Board of Directors. Hogan joined Cellebrite as Executive Chairman in August 2023, became interim CEO in January 2025 and was subsequently appointed CEO in August 2025.
